message: Afternoon Christian. It's been 16 days since I last checked in, so let's catch up properly — there's real movement, both good and worth watching.

Start with the best part: Naomi Cameron came back. That $87 order I flagged as expired on the 12th is still sitting unpaid, but she placed a new order on the 13th for $136 and it's paid and fulfilled. That's a customer worth a thank-you message, and the old $87 is still recoverable if you resend the link.

The habit system you built on the 12th worked — properly. 46 tasks done the week of the 13th, 27 the week after, karma up 306 points. But the last three days have been quiet and today reset the streak to zero. Nothing's broken, it's just the first wobble — worth a look at what changed this week.

On money: the overdue pile shrank a lot — Internet, the CBA personal loan, ChatGPT, and Fitness Passports are all cleared since last time. What's left is $136 overdue (led by the CBA credit card, still your priority debt at 20.99%) and $60 due today. And Square's connector needs reauthorizing on your end — I can only see revenue through the 4th, so the July figure is likely short.
One thing I can't move forward without you: it's been 23 days since the marathon and there's still no next goal. Whenever you've picked one, tell me and I'll rebuild the training block.
